title: thelypteris brachypus
intro: Thelypteris brachypus, commonly known as the Autumn Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Thelypteris brachypus contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
